0022600210.text: The Golden State Warriors (7-3, 5-1 at home) host the New Orleans Pelicans in the Warriors' 11th game of the season, with Golden State riding a seven-game winning streak and sitting 2nd in the Pacific, one game back, and 5th in the West. New Orleans comes in at 4-5 after a loss, sitting 11th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 3 games back, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though they lost 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026, and the two teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season. Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise).
